mentions.name: qftf
mentions.description: A small utility that transfers files between two computers using QR codes, functioning like Magic Wormhole but without any typing. It uses iroh for peer-to-peer networking on both ends, as well as in the web app used to scan the QR codes and start the transfer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a little utility to transfer files between two computers using QR codes: https://github.com/cibyr/qftf

It's kinda like Magic Wormhole without typing. It uses iroh for the p2p networking - on both ends, and also in the little web app that you use to scan the QR codes and start the transfer.
